problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of trucks from distribution hubs to retail outlets in a manner that minimizes total fuel expenditure.

The number of trucks available at each distribution hub (set H) is specified as:  
*Hub Alpha has 101 vehicles.  
*Hub Beta has 81 vehicles.  
*Hub Gamma has 84 vehicles.  
*Hub Delta has 68 vehicles.  
*Hub Epsilon has 165 vehicles.  
*Hub Zeta has 94 vehicles.  
*Hub Eta has 163 vehicles.

The required number of deliveries at each retail outlet (set R) is as follows:  
*Outlet P requires 117 trucks.  
*Outlet Q requires 140 trucks.  
*Outlet S requires 142 trucks.  
*Outlet T requires 96 trucks.  
*Outlet U requires 102 trucks.  
*Outlet V requires 79 trucks.  
*Outlet W requires 41 trucks.

The fuel cost per truck dispatched from each hub to each outlet is provided in the table:

| Hub / Outlet | P | Q | S | T | U | V | W |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alpha   | 10 | 6 | 6 | 12 | 17 | 8 | 4 |
| Beta    | 7 | 5 | 8 | 16 | 1 | 12 | 18 |
| Gamma   | 19 | 12 | 15 | 18 | 5 | 20 | 3 |
| Delta   | 3 | 10 | 13 | 16 | 17 | 14 | 14 |
| Epsilon | 19 | 3 | 5 | 11 | 3 | 15 | 15 |
| Zeta    | 17 | 12 | 5 | 18 | 19 | 6 | 5 |
| Eta     | 14 | 17 | 2 | 4 | 17 | 5 | 10 |

Determine the optimal assignment of trucks from hubs to outlets so that the overall fuel consumption cost is minimized.
